title: Connector manifest
description: The ten-line published artifact naming a connector image and where to find its config spec. See spec/manifest.md for field-by-field prose.

name.description: Connector identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric, may contain internal hyphens; must start with a letter or digit.

class.description: Which side of the data flow the connector occupies.

image.description: Container image reference, digest-pinned. A mutable tag is rejected.

contract.description: The contract version this manifest and its image implement (D-1).

spec.description: Where to find the connector's config spec document: the literal "embedded" (invoke the image's `spec` entrypoint, D-11/D-12) or a URI to a catalog-hosted, pre-extracted spec document. The URI branch is matched by scheme prefix, not the (optionally-asserted) `format` keyword, so the distinction holds under every JSON Schema implementation.

icon.description: Optional display icon (URI or inline reference; rendering is catalog/UI concern).
